learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will learn the structure of formal writing, specifically focusing on drafting a formal leave application to the Principal and structuring a logical paragraph.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 There are times when we write casually to our friends, and times when we must write respectfully to teachers or principals. Today, we put on our professional hats and learn formal writing! 🎩

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A formal letter has a strict layout. We must include: 1. The Receiver's Address (To the Principal), 2. Date, 3. Subject (Why you are writing), 4. Salutation (Respected Sir/Madam), 5. Body, 6. Closing (Yours obediently), and 7. Your Name/Class.
examples_or_templates: Subject: Application for two days sick leave.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: The body of a formal letter must be polite, clear, and to the point. It usually has three parts: Who you are, why you are writing, and what action you are requesting.
examples_or_templates: "I am a student of Class 4. I am suffering from a fever..."
"Kindly grant me leave for two days..."

lesson_modules.teaching_content: Whether writing a letter or an essay, paragraphs need structure. Every good paragraph needs a Topic Sentence (the main idea), Supporting Sentences (details/reasons), and a Concluding Sentence (wrap up).
examples_or_templates: Supporting: They are loyal, playful, and protect the house.
Conclusion: That is why dogs are known as man's best friend.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ What is the most appropriate closing for a formal application to the Principal?
❓ What is the purpose of the 'Subject' line in a formal letter?
options: To state the main reason for the letter briefly.
practice_mcq_quiz.correct_answer: To state the main reason for the letter briefly.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write a short and clear 'Subject' line for an application asking for leave to attend your sister's wedding.
subjective_practice.hint: Keep it under 6-7 words. Start with 'Application for...'

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Arrange these parts of a formal letter in the correct order: Date, Subject, Receiver's Address, Salutation.
subjective_practice.hint: Who are you sending it to? When? Why? Hello.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write a Topic Sentence for a paragraph about the importance of drinking water.
subjective_practice.hint: State the main idea clearly in one sentence.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🖋️ Be the Principal's Pen Pal
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Draft a complete formal leave application to your school Principal asking for one day of leave because you have to go to the dentist. Make sure to use all 7 parts of the formal format!

chapter_summary: ⭐ Formal letters follow a strict format including the receiver's address, date, subject, and polite closing.
⭐ The body of a formal letter must be respectful, clear, and direct.
⭐ A good paragraph always contains a Topic sentence, Supporting details, and a Conclusion.
